verdict.rationale: Skills/plugins let Claude invoke packaged capabilities automatically within a session or via slash-command trigger, but nothing in the evidence describes scheduling, cron-like triggers, or agents running unattended in the background without a live user session — the closest is hooks/agents in plugins, which aren't documented as autonomous background schedulers. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/triggered background execution, evidence of unattended run completion/notification, and any docs framing skills as an automation/orchestration layer rather than an in-session capability library.
